channel_basis.edge: fractional Canny XOR on a common image grid
channel_basis.clip: half chord distance on separately normalized whole-image vision embeddings, no prompt
channel_basis.sift: conditional inlier-fraction complement, comparison-specific domain. Keep all pair geometry; do not use in metric path or group progress
channel_basis.aligned: directional valid-overlap registered residual with optional held-out gain-offset. Domains may differ. Keep raw form and applicability, do not sum or divide into progress

group_reduction: Median of valid distances within each common channel using at least two prototypes, skipping exact prototype self-pairs. Boundary point zero permitted only for identical rank in the metric endpoint distance, never used for scoring prototypes. Keep pair-level records.
selection: One actual interior coarse sample per route and per pair. Time midpoint, gray anchor equal-distance, gray path midpoint, gray Gaussian multiscale medoid and two-domain local support are separate. Gray anchor nearest balance is a candidate even if no crossing; the intersection status is recorded separately. Secondary diagnostic all channels. No best channel chosen after evaluation.
evaluation: Mechanical oracle, two known Phase 1 replay cases, reverse doorway and in-room pan return transfer diagnostics. All references used only after predictions. Manual anchor input frozen independently and separate. All labelled windows conservative 2D visibility; model understanding not implied.
